title: Dominic and the Prom
author: Astrid Iversen
blurb: Wren Ravensworth, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
